tutorial.html:
Hearts (Declarative)

Follow the led suit when possible. Hearts are worth one point and the queen of spades is worth thirteen. The lowest score wins after thirteen tricks.

Tap one of the legal cards highlighted in your hand. The trick, score totals, and whether hearts have been broken are visible.
